en.t: Battle of the Gates of Trajan
en.s: The Battle of the Gates of Trajan (Bulgarian: Битка край Траянови врати, Medieval Greek: Μάχη στις Πύλες του Τραϊανού) was a battle between Byzantine and Bulgarian forces in the year 986. It took place in the pass of the same name, modern Trayanovi Vrata, in Sofia Province, Bulgaria. It was the largest defeat of the Byzantines under Emperor Basil II.

zh.s: 特拉扬门战役是986年拜占庭帝国与保加利亚军队之间的一场战斗，发生在今保加利亚索菲亚州的特拉扬诺维瓦拉山口。拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世在此遭遇了他统治期间最惨重的一次失败。

en.s: The battle of Hama happened in August 1178, when a Latin force raided the vicinity of Hama, which was under Ayyubid control. The Ayyubid repelled the raid and captured many prisoners who would be later executed.

zh.s: 1178年8月，一支拉丁军队袭击了由阿尤布王朝控制的哈马附近地区。阿尤布军队击退了袭击，并俘虏了许多人，这些俘虏后来遭到处决。

en.s: The Battle of Soindres or the Battle of Mantes was a military engagement between Kingdom of France and Kingdom of England that took place on August 17, 1188 near the village of Soindres, north-western France, as part of the First Hundred Years' War.

zh.s: 1188年8月17日，法国王国与英格兰王国在法国西北部索安德尔村附近交战。这场战斗也称芒特战役，是第一次百年战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Yaroslavl (1245) was a battle fought on 17 August 1245 near San next to the town of Yaroslavl, between the Kingdom of Galicia–Volhynia led by Daniel of Galicia and Vasylko Romanovych supported by the Cumans and the Galician opposition supported by Hungarians and Poles. The battle resulted in the defeat of the Galician opposition.

zh.s: 1245年8月17日，桑河附近雅罗斯瓦夫镇旁爆发战斗。交战双方是丹尼尔·罗曼诺维奇和瓦西里科·罗曼诺维奇率领、由库曼人支持的加利西亚—沃里尼亚王国军队，以及得到匈牙利人和波兰人支持的加利西亚反对派。战斗以加利西亚反对派战败告终。

en.s: The siege of Ceuta of 1419 (sometimes reported as 1418) was fought between the besieging forces of the Marinid sultanate, led by Sultan Abu Said Uthman III, including allied forces from the Emirate of Granada, and the Portuguese garrison of Ceuta, led by Pedro de Menezes, 1st Count of Vila Real.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1419年的休达围城战（有时也记作1418年）中，马林王朝军队围攻葡萄牙守军。马林王朝军队由苏丹阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼三世率领，并有格拉纳达埃米尔国盟军参战；葡萄牙守军由比拉雷亚尔第一代伯爵佩德罗·德·梅内塞斯指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Verneuil was a strategically important battle of the Hundred Years' War, fought on 17 August 1424 near Verneuil in Normandy and a significant English victory. It was a particularly bloody battle, described by the English as a second Agincourt. Altogether some 7262 French and allied troops were killed, including 4000 Scots. English losses were 1600, including two men-at-arms and "a very few archers". The Scots army, led by Archibald, Earl of Douglas and John Stewart, Earl of Buchan (both of whom were killed), was almost destroyed.

zh.s: 韦尔讷伊战役是百年战争中的一场重要战役，于1424年8月17日在诺曼底韦尔讷伊附近爆发，英军取得重大胜利。这是一场极其血腥的战斗，英格兰人称之为“第二次阿金库尔战役”。法军及其盟军约有7,262人阵亡，其中包括4,000名苏格兰人。英军损失1,600人，其中包括两名重装骑兵和“极少数弓箭手”。阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯伯爵和约翰·斯图尔特·巴肯伯爵率领的苏格兰军几乎全军覆没，两位伯爵也都阵亡。

en.s: The Siege of Rhodes of 1480 was the first and failed attempt by the Ottoman Empire to seize the island stronghold of the Knights of Rhodes from Rhodes, despite about 70,000 troops, they successfully defended the island.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1480年，奥斯曼帝国首次尝试攻占罗得岛骑士团在罗得岛的堡垒，但未能成功。尽管奥斯曼军队约有70,000人，骑士团仍成功守住了该岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Konrad Bitz dates the preface to Missale Aboense
en.s: On August 17, 1488, Bishop Konrad Bitz dated his preface to Missale Aboense in Turku, in present-day Finland. The missal was printed later that year in Lübeck for the Diocese of Turku.
en.n: Date of the preface; the book’s printing is not dated to this day.

zh.t: 康拉德·比茨为《图尔库弥撒经书》序言署上日期
zh.s: 1488年8月17日，图尔库主教康拉德·比茨在《图尔库弥撒经书》（Missale Aboense）的序言上署上日期，地点在今芬兰的图尔库。这部弥撒经书随后于同年在吕贝克印刷，供图尔库教区使用。
zh.n: 日期来自序言落款，不能据此认定经书也在当天印刷。

en.t: Cesare Borgia, son of Pope Alexander VI, becomes the first person in history to resign the cardinalate; later that same day, King Louis XII of France names him Duke of Valentinois
en.s: Cesare Borgia (13 September 1475 – 12 March 1507) was an Italian cardinal deacon and later a condottiero, as well as a member of the Spanish House of Borgia. He was the illegitimate son of Pope Alexander VI and sibling to Lucrezia Borgia. After initially entering the Church and becoming a cardinal on his father's election to the papacy, he resigned his diaconal profession after his brother was murdered in 1497.

zh.t: 切萨雷·波吉亚辞去枢机职务，后于同日获封瓦朗蒂努瓦公爵
zh.s: 切萨雷·波吉亚（1475年9月13日—1507年3月12日）是意大利执事级枢机，后来成为军事统帅，也是西班牙波吉亚家族成员。他是教皇亚历山大六世的私生子，也是卢克雷齐娅·波吉亚的兄弟。他最初进入教会，在父亲当选教皇后成为枢机；1497年兄长遇害后，他辞去教会职务。

en.s: The Prayer Book Rebellion or Western Rising was a popular revolt in Cornwall and Devon in 1549. In that year, the first Book of Common Prayer, presenting the theology of the English Reformation, was introduced. The change was widely unpopular, particularly in areas where firm Catholic religious loyalty (even after the Act of Supremacy in 1534) still existed, such as Lancashire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 祈祷书起义又称西部起义，是1549年康沃尔和德文郡的一场民众起义。同年，首版《公祷书》问世，其中体现了英国宗教改革的神学思想。这项改革广受反对，尤其是在仍坚定信奉天主教的地区，例如兰开夏郡；当地的天主教传统在1534年《至尊法案》颁布后仍然根深蒂固。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Scotland’s Parliament adopts the Scots Confession
en.s: On August 17, 1560, Scotland’s Parliament in Edinburgh approved the Scots Confession, a Protestant statement of faith. The vote was a key step in the Scottish Reformation; separate measures against papal authority and the Mass followed later that month.
en.n: This records approval of the confession, rather than treating all Reformation legislation as one action on this date.

zh.t: 苏格兰议会通过《苏格兰信条》
zh.s: 1560年8月17日，苏格兰议会在爱丁堡通过新教的《苏格兰信条》。这次表决是苏格兰宗教改革的重要一步；废除教皇权威、禁止天主教弥撒等其他措施，是当月稍后通过的。
zh.n: 此条记录为信条获通过，不把当月其他宗教改革法案也算在同一天。

en.s: On August 17, 1585, Antwerp surrendered to Spanish forces led by Alessandro Farnese after more than a year under siege during the Eighty Years’ War. The surrender terms gave the city’s Protestants four years to settle their affairs and leave.
en.n: Date of the surrender; the siege began in July 1584.

zh.t: 安特卫普向西班牙军队投降
zh.s: 1585年8月17日，安特卫普在被围困一年多后，向亚历山德罗·法尔内塞率领的西班牙军队投降。这是八十年战争中的一场围城战。投降条款给予城内新教徒四年时间处理财产等事务，然后离开。
zh.n: 日期为投降当天；围城始于1584年7月。

en.s: The Battle of Casa Forte was the second major clash in the War of Divine Light, fought between Dutch troops and Portuguese militias. The confrontation took place in 1645 and ended in a Portuguese victory. After the defeat suffered by the Dutch army against the Portuguese in the Battle of Tabocas, the Dutch troops marched back to Recife and camped at the Casa Forte mill belonging to Anna Paes.

zh.s: 卡萨福尔特战役是“神圣之光战争”中的第二场主要交战，参战方为荷兰军队和葡萄牙民兵。战斗发生于1645年，以葡萄牙获胜告终。此前荷兰军队在塔博卡斯战役中败给葡萄牙军队，随后撤回累西腓，并在安娜·派斯的卡萨福尔特磨坊扎营。

en.s: The Battle of Preston (17–19 August 1648), fought largely at Walton-le-Dale near Preston in Lancashire, resulted in a victory for the New Model Army under the command of Oliver Cromwell over the Royalists and Scots commanded by the Duke of Hamilton. The Parliamentarian victory presaged the end of the Second English Civil War.

zh.s: 普雷斯顿战役于1648年8月17日至19日进行，主要战场位于兰开夏郡普雷斯顿附近的沃尔顿勒戴尔。奥利弗·克伦威尔率领的新模范军击败了汉密尔顿公爵指挥的保王党和苏格兰军队。议会军获胜，预示着第二次英格兰内战即将结束。

en.s: Northern Anatolia was struck by a large earthquake on 17 August 1668 in the late morning. It had an estimated magnitude in the range 7.8–8.0 Ms and the maximum felt intensity was IX on the Modified Mercalli intensity scale. The epicenter of the earthquake was on the southern shore of Ladik Lake. It caused widespread damage from as far west as Bolu and as far east as Erzincan, resulting in about 8,000 deaths.

zh.s: 1668年8月17日上午较晚时分，安纳托利亚北部发生强烈地震，估计震级为7.8至8.0 Ms，修订麦加利地震烈度表的最高烈度达到IX级。震中位于拉迪克湖南岸。地震造成大范围破坏，西至博卢、东至埃尔津詹均受影响，约8,000人死亡。

en.t: Scanian War: Swedish forces defeated Danish troops at the Battle of Halmstad
en.s: The Battle of Halmstad, also known as the Battle at Fyllebro, was fought on 17 August 1676, at Fyllebro, approximately 4 km (2.5 mi) southeast of the town of Halmstad in the province of Halland in southwest Sweden. It was the last battle fought in Halland between Denmark and Sweden.

zh.t: 斯堪尼亚战争：瑞典军队在哈尔姆斯塔德战役中击败丹麦军队
zh.s: 哈尔姆斯塔德战役也称菲勒布罗战役，于1676年8月17日在瑞典西南部哈兰省的菲勒布罗爆发，地点位于哈尔姆斯塔德镇东南约4公里（2.5英里）。这是丹麦与瑞典在哈兰省进行的最后一场战斗。

en.s: The siege of Érsekújvár was fought between July 7 and August 17 of 1685, between the besieging Habsburg army and the Ottoman garrison of Érsekújvár, city in what is today Nové Zámky, Slovakia (Turkish: Uyvar). The Austrian commander, Aeneas de Caprara, invested the city and stormed it on August 17, slaying the entire Ottoman garrison.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 埃尔谢库伊堡围城战（1685年）
zh.s: 1685年7月7日至8月17日，哈布斯堡军队围攻埃尔谢库伊堡，守军为奥斯曼军队。该城今属斯洛伐克新扎姆基（土耳其语：Uyvar）。奥地利指挥官埃涅阿斯·德·卡普拉拉包围城市，并于8月17日发动强攻，杀死全部奥斯曼守军。

en.s: The action of 17 August 1779 was a naval battle between a French and a British squadron in the English Channel on 17 August 1779. In June 1779, Spain followed France declaring war on Britain and together formed a combined fleet aiming for British Isles' invasion. On 14 August, the fleet was off the Lizard and on 16 August the ships were off Plymouth with some of the enemy frigates anchored in the Cawsand Bay.

zh.s: 1779年8月17日，法国和英国分舰队在英吉利海峡交战。1779年6月，西班牙跟随法国向英国宣战，并与法国组成联合舰队，计划入侵不列颠群岛。8月14日，舰队抵达利扎德角附近；8月16日，舰船来到普利茅斯外海，部分敌方护卫舰停泊在考桑德湾。

en.s: The Battle of Lincelles was an action that took place as part of a larger manoeuvre on 17 August 1793 in the Flanders Campaign of the War of the First Coalition. It was fought between the forces of Revolutionary France under the command of Jean Baptiste Jourdan and Antoine Anne Lecourt de Béru, versus those of Great Britain under the Frederick Augustus, Duke of York and Albany and the Dutch Republic under the Hereditary Prince of Orange. The action resulted in a coalition victory.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争的佛兰德斯战役期间，1793年8月17日发生了利塞勒战役，这是更大规模军事行动的一部分。交战双方是让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当和安托万-安娜·勒库尔·德·贝吕指挥的法兰西革命军，以及约克和奥尔巴尼公爵弗雷德里克·奥古斯都率领的英国军队和奥兰治亲王率领的荷兰共和国军队。反法同盟一方获胜。

en.s: The capitulation of Saldanha Bay was the surrender to the British of a Batavian expeditionary force sent to recapture the Dutch Cape Colony in 1796 as part of the East Indies theatre of the French Revolutionary Wars. During the Flanders campaign of the War of the First Coalition, French troops overran the Dutch Republic in December 1794, leading to the latter becoming a French client state known as the Batavian Republic.

zh.s: 1796年，巴达维亚共和国派出一支远征军，试图夺回荷兰开普殖民地；这支部队最终向英国投降。这场投降发生在法国大革命战争的东印度战区。第一次反法同盟战争期间，法军于1794年12月攻占荷兰共和国，后者因此成为法国的附庸国巴达维亚共和国。

en.t: August 1798 United States Senate special election in New York
en.s: The second 1798 United States Senate special election in New York was held on August 17, 1798, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1798年8月纽约州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 纽约州议会于1798年8月17日举行第二次联邦参议员特别选举，选出一名代表纽约州的联邦参议员（第一组席位）。

en.s: The combat of Gavi was fought to no strategic avail on the morning of 17 August (O.S. 6 Aug.) 1799 during the Second Coalition war, in pursuit of the defeated French army after the battle of Novi. The combat included Rosenberg's Russian vanguard, under Rehbinder's command. In the combat, the Russians managed to push the French back towards Gavi.

zh.s: 第二次反法同盟战争期间，1799年8月17日（旧历8月6日）上午，俄军追击诺维战役中战败的法军，在加维附近交战，但没有取得战略成果。战斗中，赖宾德指挥罗森堡的俄军先头部队，俄军将法军击退至加维方向。

en.s: The Battle of Alavus took place on 17 August 1808 in the vicinity of the town of Alavus (Swedish: Alavo), as part of the Finnish War. The Finnish army, under the command of general Carl Johan Adlercreutz defeated a smaller Russian force and drove it southwards. It was the last in a string of Swedish successes during the summer of 1808, and marked the turning point in the war.

zh.s: 芬兰战争期间，1808年8月17日，阿拉武斯（瑞典语：Alavo）镇附近爆发战斗。卡尔·约翰·阿德勒克罗伊茨将军率领芬兰军队击败规模较小的俄军，并将其赶往南方。这是瑞典军队在1808年夏季一连串胜利中的最后一场，也成为战争的转折点。

en.s: In the Battle of Roliça (17 August 1808) an Anglo-Portuguese army under Sir Arthur Wellesley defeated an outnumbered French army under General Henri Delaborde, near the village of Roliça in Portugal. The French retired in good order. Formerly spelled Roleia in English, it was the first battle fought by the British army during the Peninsular War.

zh.s: 1808年8月17日，亚瑟·韦尔斯利爵士率领的英葡联军在葡萄牙罗利萨村附近击败人数较少的法军，法军有序撤退。这是英国军队在半岛战争中参加的第一场战斗；该地名过去在英语中拼作Roleia。

en.s: The Battle of Aragua de Barcelona (Spanish: Batalla de Aragua de Barcelona) was fought between Royalists of the Spanish Empire and the Second Republic of Venezuela on 17 August 1814. The battle saw Royalists attack Simón Bolívar's force of 3,000 and win with their 8,000 soldiers. It was a major loss for the Patriots.

zh.s: 1814年8月17日，西班牙帝国保王党与委内瑞拉第二共和国军队爆发巴塞罗那阿拉瓜战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Aragua de Barcelona）。保王党以8,000兵力进攻西蒙·玻利瓦尔率领的3,000人部队并获胜，这是爱国者一方的一次重大失利。

en.s: The Bombardment of Mogador took place August 15–17, 1844, when French Navy forces under the Prince de Joinville attacked the Moroccan city of Mogador, modern Essaouira, and the island facing the city, Mogador island. The campaign was part of the Franco-Moroccan War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1844年8月15日至17日，儒安维尔亲王率领的法国海军袭击摩洛哥城市莫加多尔（今索维拉）及其对面同名岛屿。这场行动是法摩战争的一部分。

en.s: The Dakota War of 1862, also known as the Sioux Uprising, (and the Dakota Uprising, the Sioux Outbreak of 1862, the Dakota Conflict, the U.S.–Dakota War of 1862 or Little Crow's War) was an armed conflict between the United States and several bands of Dakota (also known as the eastern 'Sioux'). It began on August 17, 1862, along the Minnesota River in southwest Minnesota. It ended with a mass execution of 38 Dakota men on December 26, 1862, in Mankato, Minnesota. Throughout the late 1850s, treaty violations by the United States and late or unfair annuity payments by Indian agents caused increasing hunger and hardship among the Dakota.
en.n: This entry records the killings at Acton on 17 August 1862, preceding the attacks at the Lower Sioux Agency the next day.

zh.s: 1862年达科他战争也称苏族起义、达科他起义、1862年苏族暴乱、达科他冲突、美达科他战争或小乌鸦战争，是美国与数支达科他族（也称东部苏族）部族之间的武装冲突。战争于1862年8月17日在明尼苏达州西南部的明尼苏达河沿岸爆发，最终于同年12月26日在明尼苏达州曼凯托处决38名达科他族男子。19世纪50年代后期，美国违反条约，印第安事务官又迟发或不公发放年金，导致达科他族人日益饥饿、生活困苦。
zh.n: 此条记录的是1862年8月17日阿克顿发生的杀戮事件，早于次日在下苏族机构的袭击。

en.s: The Bombardment of Kagoshima, also known as the Anglo-Satsuma War (薩英戦争, Satsu-Ei Sensō), was a military engagement fought between Britain and the Satsuma Domain in Kagoshima from 15 to 17 August 1863. The British were attempting to extract compensation and legal justice from daimyo Shimazu Tadayoshi for the 1862 Namamugi incident. The engagement began when a Royal Navy fleet commanded by Sir Augustus Kuper was fired on from Satsuma coastal batteries near Kagoshima.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1863年8月15日至17日，英国与萨摩藩在鹿儿岛交战，这场战事也称英萨战争（薩英戦争，Satsu-Ei Sensō）。英国试图就1862年生麦事件向大名岛津忠义索取赔偿并追究其法律责任。奥古斯都·库珀爵士率领的英国皇家海军舰队在鹿儿岛附近遭到萨摩沿岸炮台射击，战斗由此开始。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Gainesville was an American Civil War engagement fought on August 17, 1864, when a Confederate force defeated Union detachments from Jacksonville, Florida. The result of the battle was the Confederate occupation of Gainesville for the remainder of the war.

zh.s: 1864年8月17日，美国内战期间，一支邦联军队击败了从佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔派出的联邦军分队。邦联军随后占领盖恩斯维尔，并控制该地直到战争结束。

en.s: In the Paraguayan war, the Battle of Yatai was fought on August 17, 1865 between the troops of the Triple Alliance (Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay) and the soldiers of Paraguay near Paso de los Libres, Corrientes, Argentina. The Battle of Yatai was the first major land battle of the Paraguayan war, and most important of the war's second phase.

zh.s: 1865年8月17日，巴拉圭战争期间，三国同盟（阿根廷、巴西和乌拉圭）军队与巴拉圭军队在阿根廷科连特斯省帕索德洛斯利布雷斯附近交战。这是巴拉圭战争中的第一场重大战役，也是战争第二阶段最重要的一场战斗。

en.s: The Powder River Massacre, part of the Powder River Expedition, occurred on August 17, 1865, and was carried out by United States soldiers and Pawnee scouts against 24 Cheyenne people. The incident occurred near the Powder River in Dakota Territory, in present-day Johnson County, Wyoming.

zh.s: 1865年8月17日，波德河远征期间，美国士兵和波尼族侦察兵在波德河附近袭击了24名夏延族人。当时该地属于达科他领地，如今位于怀俄明州约翰逊县。

en.t: Baden signs peace and alliance treaties with Prussia
en.s: On August 17, 1866, Baden and Prussia signed peace and alliance treaties in Berlin after the Austro-Prussian War. The alliance committed the two states to mutual military support and placed Baden’s troops under the Prussian king’s command in wartime.
en.n: The date refers to the treaties’ signature, not a separately verified withdrawal announcement.

zh.t: 巴登与普鲁士签署和平及同盟条约
zh.s: 1866年8月17日，巴登与普鲁士在柏林签署和平及同盟条约，为普奥战争后的关系作出安排。同盟条约规定双方在战争中相互支援，届时巴登军队由普鲁士国王统一指挥。
zh.n: 日期指条约签署日；并未单独证实宣布退出邦联也发生在当天。

en.s: On August 17, 1876, Richard Wagner’s opera Götterdämmerung premiered at the Bayreuth Festspielhaus in Germany. It is the final opera in his four-part Ring cycle, and its premiere formed part of the first complete performance of the cycle.

zh.t: 瓦格纳的《诸神的黄昏》在拜罗伊特首演
zh.s: 1876年8月17日，理查德·瓦格纳的歌剧《诸神的黄昏》在德国拜罗伊特节日剧院首演。它是《尼伯龙根的指环》四部歌剧中的最后一部，这次首演也是整套作品首次完整演出的一部分。

en.t: Pike Place Market, one of the oldest continuously operated public farmers' markets in the U.S. and a popular tourist attraction, opens in Seattle, Washington
en.s: Pike Place Market is a public market in Seattle, Washington, United States. It opened on August 17, 1907, and is one of the older continuously operated public farmers' markets in the United States. Overlooking the Elliott Bay waterfront on Puget Sound, it serves as a place of business for many small farmers, craftspeople and merchants.

zh.t: 派克市场在华盛顿州西雅图开业，成为美国持续营业时间最长的公共农贸市场之一和热门景点
zh.s: 派克市场是美国华盛顿州西雅图的一处公共市场，于1907年8月17日开业，是美国持续营业时间较长的公共农贸市场之一，也是热门旅游景点。市场俯瞰普吉特海湾的埃利奥特湾海滨，为许多小农户、手工艺人和商贩提供经营场所。

en.s: The 1911 Christchurch North by-election was a by-election during the 17th New Zealand Parliament held on 17 August that year in the Christchurch North electorate. It was triggered by the death of sitting member Tommy Taylor on 27 July and was won by his close friend and political ally, Leonard Isitt.

zh.s: 新西兰第17届议会期间，基督城北选区于1911年8月17日举行补选。补选由在任议员汤米·泰勒于7月27日去世引发，最终由他的好友和政治盟友伦纳德·伊西特胜出。

en.s: The Battle of Stallupönen, fought between Russian and German armies on August 17, 1914, was the opening battle of World War I on the Eastern Front. The Germans under the command of Hermann von François conducted a successful counterattack against four Russian infantry divisions from different infantry corps, which heavily outnumbered them but were separated from each other, creating a gap between the 27th Infantry Division and the 40th Infantry Division, and had little coordination with each other.

zh.s: 1914年8月17日，俄军与德军爆发斯塔卢珀嫩战役，这是第一次世界大战东线的首场战斗。赫尔曼·冯·弗朗索瓦率领德军成功反击四个俄军步兵师。这些部队人数远多于德军，但分属不同军，彼此分散；第27步兵师与第40步兵师之间出现缺口，部队之间协同也很有限。

en.s: The National Defence coup d'état (Greek: Κίνημα της Εθνικής Αμύνης) was a military uprising in Thessaloniki on 17 August 1916, by Hellenic Army officers opposed to the neutrality followed by the royal government in Athens during World War I, and sympathetic to former Prime Minister Eleftherios Venizelos and the Entente Powers.

zh.s: 1916年8月17日，希腊陆军军官在塞萨洛尼基发动军事起义，反对一战期间雅典王室政府奉行的中立政策，并支持前总理埃莱夫塞里奥斯·韦尼泽洛斯和协约国。这场政变也称国防运动（希腊语：Κίνημα της Εθνικής Αμύνης）。

en.t: World War I: Romania signs a secret treaty with the Entente Powers. According to the treaty, Romania agreed to join the war on the Allied side
en.s: The Treaty of Bucharest of 1916 was signed between Romania and the Entente Powers on 4 (Old Style)/17 (New Style) August 1916 in Bucharest. The treaty stipulated the conditions under which Romania agreed to join the war on the side of the Entente, particularly territorial promises in Austria-Hungary. The signatories bound themselves to keep secret the contents of the treaty until a general peace was concluded.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战：罗马尼亚与协约国签订秘密条约，承诺加入协约国一方参战
zh.s: 1916年8月4日（旧历）／8月17日（新历），罗马尼亚与协约国在布加勒斯特签署《布加勒斯特条约》。条约规定罗马尼亚加入协约国一方参战的条件，尤其涉及奥匈帝国境内的领土承诺。各签署方承诺，在达成全面和平之前对条约内容保密。

en.s: The Battle of Paprotzan (Polish: Bitwa o Paprocany) was a battle during the First Silesian Uprising that occurred on 17 August 1919 in the village of Paprotzan on the outskirts of Tichau, and resulted in a Polish victory. The Battle of Paprotzan is considered the most significant insurgent victory of the First Silesian Uprising in the Pleß district.

zh.s: 1919年8月17日，第一次西里西亚起义期间，帕普罗查内村发生战斗，该村位于蒂豪郊外。波兰一方获胜。这被认为是普莱斯县第一次西里西亚起义中起义军最重要的一场胜利。战役的波兰语名称为Bitwa o Paprocany。

en.s: Battle of Zadwórze (sometimes referred to as the "Polish Thermopylae") was a battle of the Polish-Soviet War. It was fought on August 17, 1920 near the train station of Zadwórze, a small village located 33 kilometres from the city centre of Lwów (now Lviv). The battle, lasting roughly 24 hours, resulted in the complete destruction of the Polish forces but at the same time halted the Soviet advance, preventing the forces of Siemion Budionnyi from seizing Lwów and so contributing to the successful defence of Warsaw. The battle has been called a Polish Thermopylae.

zh.s: 扎德武热战役有时也称“波兰温泉关之战”，是波苏战争中的一场战斗。1920年8月17日，战斗在扎德武热火车站附近爆发；扎德武热是一个小村庄，距利沃夫（今利维夫）市中心33公里。战斗持续约24小时，波兰军队全军覆没，但也阻止了苏军继续推进，挡住谢苗·布琼尼部队攻占利沃夫，为成功保卫华沙作出了贡献。这场战斗因此被称为“波兰温泉关之战”。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Fawkner on 17 August 1935. This was triggered by the death of United Australia Party (UAP) MP George Maxwell. The by-election was won by UAP candidate and future Prime Minister Harold Holt.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院福克纳选区于1935年8月17日举行补选，起因是统一澳大利亚党（UAP）议员乔治·麦克斯韦去世。UAP候选人、后来出任总理的哈罗德·霍尔特赢得补选。

en.s: The 1936 Quebec general election was held on August 17, 1936, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The Union Nationale, led by Maurice Duplessis, defeated the incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Adélard Godbout. This marked the end of slightly more than 39 consecutive years in power for the Liberals, who had governed Quebec since the 1897 election.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省于1936年8月17日举行大选，选出魁北克省议会议员。莫里斯·杜普莱西领导的民族联盟击败了阿德拉尔·戈德布领导的魁北克自由党。这结束了自由党连续执政略超39年的局面；该党自1897年选举以来一直执政魁北克。

en.s: The raid on Makin Island was an attack by Marine Raiders of the United States Marine Corps on the Japanese-controlled Makin Island from August 17–18, 1942. Aims of the raid included destroying local installations, acquiring prisoners of war and military intelligence on the Gilbert Islands, and diverting Japanese attention and reinforcements from the Guadalcanal campaign and battle of Tulagi and Gavutu–Tanambogo.

zh.s: 1942年8月17日至18日，美国海军陆战队突袭部队袭击了由日本控制的马金岛。行动目标包括摧毁当地设施、俘虏日军并获取有关吉尔伯特群岛的军事情报，以及转移日军对瓜达尔卡纳尔战役和图拉吉岛、加武图岛—塔南博戈岛战役的注意力与增援力量。

en.s: Crossbow was the code name in World War II for Anglo-American operations against the German long range reprisal weapons (V-weapons) programme. The primary V-weapons were the V-1 flying bomb and V-2 rocket, which were launched against Britain from 1944 to 1945 and used against continental European targets as well. Initial intelligence investigations in 1943 into the progress of German long range weapons were carried out under the code name Bodyline.
en.n: World War II: The Royal Air Force begins Operation Hydra, the first air raid of the Operation Crossbow strategic bombing campaign against Germany's V-weapon program.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，“弩箭”是英美联合行动的代号，目标是德国的远程报复武器（V武器）计划。主要V武器包括V-1飞弹和V-2火箭，它们于1944年至1945年间被用于攻击英国，也用于袭击欧洲大陆的目标。1943年，盟军以“体线”为代号，开展了对德国远程武器研发进度的初步情报调查。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战期间：英国皇家空军开始“海德拉行动”，这是针对德国V武器计划的弩箭战略轰炸行动中的首次空袭。

en.s: The Allied invasion of Sicily, also known as the Battle of Sicily and Operation Husky, was a major campaign of World War II in which Allied forces invaded the Italian island of Sicily in July 1943 and took it from the Axis forces. The island was defended by the Italian 6th Army and the German XIV Panzer Corps.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 盟军入侵西西里也称西西里战役或“哈士奇行动”，是第二次世界大战中的一场重要战役。1943年7月，盟军入侵意大利的西西里岛，并从轴心国军队手中夺取该岛。岛上由意大利第6集团军和德国第14装甲军防守。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Schweinfurt–Regensburg mission was a strategic bombing mission during World War II carried out by Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress heavy bombers of the US Army Air Forces on August 17, 1943. The mission was an ambitious plan to cripple the German aircraft industry; it was also known as the "double-strike mission" because it entailed two large forces of bombers attacking separate targets in order to disperse fighter reaction by the Luftwaffe.

zh.t: 施韦因富特—雷根斯堡轰炸行动
zh.s: 1943年8月17日，美国陆军航空队出动波音B-17“飞行堡垒”重型轰炸机，执行施韦因富特—雷根斯堡战略轰炸任务，目标是重创德国航空工业。由于两支大型轰炸机编队分别攻击不同目标，以分散德国空军战斗机的拦截力量，这次行动也称“双重打击行动”。

en.t: World War II: First Québec Conference of Winston Churchill, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and William Lyon Mackenzie King begins
en.s: The First Quebec Conference, codenamed Quadrant, was a highly secret military conference held during World War II by the governments of the United Kingdom, Canada, and the United States. It took place in Quebec City on August 17–24, 1943, at both the Citadelle and the Château Frontenac. The chief representatives were Winston Churchill and Franklin D. Roosevelt, hosted by the Canadian prime minister William Lyon Mackenzie King.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：丘吉尔、罗斯福和麦肯齐·金参加的第一次魁北克会议开幕
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国、加拿大和美国政府在高度保密的情况下举行第一次魁北克会议，代号“象限”。会议于1943年8月17日至24日在魁北克市举行，地点包括城堡要塞和芳堤娜城堡酒店。主要代表是温斯顿·丘吉尔和富兰克林·D·罗斯福，由加拿大总理威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金接待。

en.s: The Battle of Menina (Greek: Μάχη της Μενίνας) was conducted by the Greek resistance group EDES against the German garrison of the village Menina (now known as Neraida), Thesprotia, during the German occupation of Greece. They were successful and captured a large quantity of supplies.

zh.s: 德国占领希腊期间，希腊抵抗组织EDES在塞斯普罗蒂亚的梅尼纳村（今名奈拉伊达）与德国驻军交战。EDES取胜，并缴获大量物资。

en.s: The Battle of Biak was part of the Western New Guinea campaign of World War II, fought between the United States Army and the Japanese Army from May 27 to August 17, 1944. Taking place on the island of Biak, in Geelvink Bay, in present-day Indonesia, it was part of General Douglas MacArthur's South West Pacific Area's offensive drive to clear New Guinea in preparation for an invasion of the Philippines.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 比亚克战役是第二次世界大战西新几内亚战役的一部分，由美国陆军与日本陆军于1944年5月27日至8月17日交战。战斗发生在今印度尼西亚境内、极乐鸟湾的比亚克岛，是道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军在西南太平洋战区推进攻势的一部分，旨在清除新几内亚的敌军，为入侵菲律宾做准备。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Action off La Ciotat was a naval engagement on 17 August 1944 during the Second World War and was part of Operation Dragoon. Allied forces, engaged at the main landings in Vichy France, ordered a small flotilla of American and British warships to make a feint against the port city of La Ciotat. The Allies hoped to draw German forces away from the main landing zones at Cavalaire-sur-Mer, Saint-Tropez and Saint Raphaël.

zh.s: 1944年8月17日，第二次世界大战期间，盟军在拉西奥塔附近发生海上交战，这是“龙骑兵行动”的一部分。当时盟军主力正在维希法国实施登陆，于是命令一支由少量美英军舰组成的舰队佯攻港口城市拉西奥塔，试图把德军从卡瓦莱尔滨海、圣特罗佩和圣拉斐尔的主要登陆点引开。

en.t: Sukarno proclaims Indonesian independence in Jakarta
en.s: On August 17, 1945, Sukarno read the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence in Jakarta, accompanied by Mohammad Hatta. The two signed the declaration. Their appointment as president and vice-president followed the next day.
en.n: The declaration is dated August 17; the presidential appointments occurred on August 18.

zh.t: 苏加诺在雅加达宣读印度尼西亚独立宣言
zh.s: 1945年8月17日，苏加诺在穆罕默德·哈达陪同下，在雅加达宣读《印度尼西亚独立宣言》。两人在宣言上签名。苏加诺和哈达被任命为总统和副总统，是次日的事。
zh.n: 独立宣言于8月17日宣读；总统和副总统的任命发生在8月18日。

en.s: The Battle of Tianmen (天门战斗) took place between the nationalists and the communists immediately after World War II during the Chinese Civil War in Tianmen, Hubei, China and resulted in communist victory.

zh.s: 天门战斗发生在二战结束后不久，是国共内战中的一场战斗。交战双方为国民党和共产党军队，地点在中国湖北天门，最终由共产党方面获胜。

en.s: The evacuation of the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo occurred during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria in August 1945, part of the last phase of World War II. The Soviets recovered territory which had been captured by Japan during the Russo-Japanese War of 1904–1905, and they dismantled the Manchurian industrial infrastructure. This deprived Chiang Kai-shek's troops of a vital region of China, and gave Mao Zedong's Eighth Army the opportunity to establish bases in North East China.
en.n: Evacuation of Manchukuo: At Talitzou by the Sino-Korean border, Puyi, then the Kangde Emperor of Manchukuo, formally renounces the imperial throne, dissolves the state, and cedes its territory to the Republic of China.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战最后阶段、苏联入侵满洲期间，1945年8月日本傀儡政权满洲国开始撤离。苏军收复了日本在1904—1905年日俄战争期间占领的领土，并拆除了满洲的工业设施。这使蒋介石的军队失去中国一处重要地区，也让毛泽东的八路军得以在中国东北建立根据地。
zh.n: 满洲国撤离：在中朝边境的塔利措，时任满洲国康德皇帝的溥仪正式放弃皇位，宣布国家解散，并将其领土交给中华民国。

en.s: The Linyi Campaign (临沂战役) was a campaign fought in Shandong, and it was a clash between the communists and the former nationalists turned Japanese puppet regime force who rejoined the nationalists, after World War II. The battle was part of the Chinese Civil War in the immediate post World War II era, and resulted in a communist victory.

en.t: The novella Animal Farm by George Orwell is first published
en.s: Animal Farm (originally Animal Farm: A Fairy Story) is a satirical allegorical dystopian novella, in the form of a beast fable, by George Orwell, first published in England on 17 August 1945. It follows the mistreated anthropomorphic farm animals of Manor Farm as they rebel against their human master, and hope to create a utopian society.

zh.t: 乔治·奥威尔的中篇小说《动物庄园》首次出版
zh.s: 乔治·奥威尔的讽刺寓言反乌托邦中篇小说《动物庄园》原名《动物庄园：一个童话故事》，于1945年8月17日在英格兰首次出版。小说采用动物寓言的形式，讲述曼纳农庄受虐待的拟人化动物反抗主人、希望建立乌托邦社会的故事。

en.s: The 1948 Alberta general election was held on August 17, 1948, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. Ernest C. Manning led the Social Credit to a fourth term in government, increasing its share of the popular vote further above the 50% mark it had set in the 1944 election. It won the same number of seats — 51 of the 57 seats in the legislature — that it had won in the previous election.

zh.s: 阿尔伯塔省于1948年8月17日举行大选，选出省议会议员。欧内斯特·C·曼宁领导社会信用党第四次执政，得票率进一步超过该党在1944年选举中达到的50%。该党获得51席，与上届选举相同；议会共有57席。

en.s: The Matsukawa derailment (松川事件 Matsukawa jiken) occurred at 0309 AM on August 17, 1949 when a Tōhoku Main Line passenger train derailed and overturned between Kanayagawa and Matsukawa stations in Fukushima Prefecture Japan, killing three crew members. Together with the Mitaka and Shimoyama incidents, it was one of three major criminal cases involving allegations of sabotage blamed by the government on Japanese Communist Party and the Japan National Railway Union in the immediate post-war era and received tremendous publicity. Twenty people were arrested and seventeen were convicted in 1953 (four of whom received death sentences), but eventually all were acquitted on appeal, and the case was closed without determining the real cause in 1970.

zh.s: 1949年8月17日凌晨3时09分，一列东北本线客车在日本福岛县金谷川站与松川站之间脱轨并倾覆，造成3名乘务人员死亡。松川事件与三鹰事件、下山事件并列为战后初期三起重大案件，政府指控日本共产党和日本国有铁道工会实施破坏活动，案件引发广泛关注。20人被捕，17人于1953年被判有罪，其中4人被判死刑；但之后所有被告在上诉中获判无罪。1970年，此案在未查明真正原因的情况下结案。

en.s: The 1949 Karlıova earthquake occurred at 18:44 UTC on 17 August with an epicenter near Karlıova in Bingöl Province, Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey. It had an estimated magnitude of 6.7, a maximum felt intensity of X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale, and caused 320–450 casualties and destroyed 3,500 buildings.

en.s: The Hill 303 massacre (Korean: 303 고지 학살 사건) was a massacre that took place during the opening days of the Korean War on August 17, 1950, on a hill above Waegwan, Republic of Korea. Forty-one United States Army (US) prisoners of war were murdered by troops of the North Korean People's Army (KPA) during one of the engagements of the Battle of Pusan Perimeter.

zh.s: 1950年8月17日，朝鲜战争初期，韩国倭馆上方的一座山丘发生屠杀事件，即303高地大屠杀（韩语：303 고지 학살 사건）。釜山环形防御圈战役的一场交战中，朝鲜人民军士兵杀害了41名美国陆军战俘。

en.t: Hurricane Diane makes landfall near Wilmington, North Carolina; it went on to cause major floods and kill more than 184 people
en.s: Hurricane Diane was the first Atlantic hurricane to cause more than an estimated $1 billion in damage ($12 billion in 2025), including direct costs and the loss of business and personal revenue. It formed on August 7 from a tropical wave between the Lesser Antilles and Cape Verde. Diane initially moved west-northwestward with little change in its intensity, but began to strengthen rapidly after turning to the north-northeast.

zh.t: 飓风黛安在北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿附近登陆；随后引发严重洪灾，造成184人以上死亡
zh.s: 飓风黛安是首个造成超过10亿美元估算损失的大西洋飓风，损失包括直接损失以及企业和个人收入损失；按2025年币值约为120亿美元。它于8月7日在小安的列斯群岛与佛得角之间的一股热带波动中形成。黛安起初向西北偏西移动，强度变化不大；转向东北偏北后开始迅速增强。

en.s: The 1959 Hebgen Lake earthquake (also known as the 1959 Yellowstone earthquake) occurred in the western United States on August 17 at 11:37 pm (MST) in southwestern Montana. The earthquake measured 7.2 on the moment magnitude scale, caused a huge landslide, resulted in over 28 fatalities and left $11 million (equivalent to $121 million in 2025) in damage.
en.n: Quake Lake is formed by the magnitude 7.2 1959 Hebgen Lake earthquake near Hebgen Lake in Montana.

zh.s: 1959年8月17日山地标准时间晚上11:37，美国西部蒙大拿州西南部发生赫布根湖地震，也称1959年黄石地震。地震矩震级为7.2级，引发巨大山体滑坡，造成28人以上死亡，损失达1,100万美元（相当于2025年的1.21亿美元）。
zh.n: 赫布根湖地震（震级7.2级）在蒙大拿州赫布根湖附近形成了地震湖（Quake Lake）。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 036 was a regularly scheduled passenger flight operated by Aeroflot from Cairo International Airport in Cairo, Egypt, to Bykovo Airport in Moscow, Soviet Union. On 17 August 1960, the Ilyushin Il-18 flying this route crashed after an engine fire. All 27 passengers and seven crew members were killed. The Air Accident Investigation Commission determined that an externally leaking fuel injector was the root cause of the accident.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空036号班机空难
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空036号班机是该公司执飞的定期客运航班，从埃及开罗的开罗国际机场飞往苏联莫斯科的比科沃机场。1960年8月17日，执飞这条航线的伊尔-18客机因发动机起火坠毁，27名乘客和7名机组人员全部遇难。航空事故调查委员会认定，燃油喷嘴向外泄漏是事故的根本原因。

en.s: Gabon, officially the Gabonese Republic, is a country on the Atlantic coast of Central Africa, lying on the equator. It is bordered by Equatorial Guinea to the northwest, Cameroon to the north, the Republic of the Congo to the east and south, while sharing a maritime border with São Tomé and Príncipe to the west in the Gulf of Guinea.

zh.s: 加蓬正式名称为加蓬共和国，位于中非大西洋沿岸，赤道穿过其境内。它西北接赤道几内亚，北接喀麦隆，东部和南部与刚果共和国接壤；西侧隔几内亚湾与圣多美和普林西比有海上边界。

en.s: The 1963 FA Charity Shield was the 41st FA Charity Shield, an annual football match held between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup competitions. The match was contested by Everton who had won the 1962–63 Football League, and Manchester United, who had won the 1962–63 FA Cup, at Goodison Park, Liverpool, on 17 August 1963.

zh.s: 1963年英格兰足总慈善盾是第41届慈善盾，每年由上赛季足球联赛和足总杯冠军对阵。本届比赛于1963年8月17日在利物浦古迪逊公园球场举行，由1962—63赛季足球联赛冠军埃弗顿对阵足总杯冠军曼联。

en.s: The Landing at Pontian (17 August 1964) was an amphibious landing made by a small body of Indonesian troops in the Pontian District, Johor, Malaysia. The landing took place during the Indonesia-Malaysia confrontation, an undeclared war fought between Malaysia and Indonesia during the early 1960s over the creation of a Malaysian Federation encompassing parts of northern Borneo, areas that Indonesia sought to increase its own power in Southeast Asia.

zh.s: 1964年8月17日，一小支印尼军队在马来西亚柔佛州笨珍县实施两栖登陆。这次行动发生在印马对抗期间。这场未宣战的战争始于20世纪60年代初，交战双方为马来西亚和印度尼西亚，争端围绕建立马来西亚联邦展开；联邦范围包括婆罗洲北部的部分地区，印尼试图借此扩大自身在东南亚的影响力。

en.s: Hurricane Camille was one of the most powerful hurricanes to make landfall in the United States when it hit southern Mississippi in August 1969. A devastating tropical cyclone, Camille was one of four Atlantic hurricanes to strike the United States as a Category 5 on the Saffir–Simpson scale, the highest category corresponding to maximum sustained winds of at least 157 mph (253 km/h).
en.n: Category 5 Hurricane Camille hits the U.S. Gulf Coast, killing 256 and causing $1.42 billion in damage.

zh.s: 1969年8月，卡米尔飓风袭击密西西比州南部登陆，是在美国登陆的最强飓风之一。卡米尔是一场破坏力极强的热带气旋，也是仅有的四场以萨菲尔—辛普森飓风等级最高级别、即五级强度袭击美国的飓风之一。五级对应持续风速至少157英里/小时（253公里/小时）。
zh.n: 五级飓风卡米尔袭击美国墨西哥湾沿岸，造成256人死亡，损失达14.2亿美元。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Parliament of Lebanon on 17 August 1970, resulting in Deputy Suleiman Frangieh being elected President of the Lebanese Republic. By convention, the presidency is always attributed to a Maronite Christian. Under the article 49 of the Lebanese Constitution, a qualified majority of two-thirds of the members of the then 99-seat Lebanese Parliament is required to elect the president in the first round.

zh.s: 黎巴嫩议会于1970年8月17日举行间接总统选举，议员苏莱曼·弗朗吉耶当选黎巴嫩共和国总统。按照惯例，总统一职由马龙派基督徒担任。根据黎巴嫩宪法第49条，总统候选人首轮必须获得当时99名议员中三分之二的支持。

en.s: The Venera program (Russian: Вене́ра, pronounced [vʲɪˈnʲɛrə] 'Venus') was a series of space probes developed by the Soviet Union between 1961 and 1984 to gather information about the planet Venus. A total of eighteen probes were sent, including two related Vega probes. Thirteen probes successfully entered the Venusian atmosphere, including the two Venera-Halley probes. Ten of those successfully landed on the surface of the planet.
en.n: Soviet Union Venera program: Venera 7 launched. It will become the first spacecraft to successfully transmit data from the surface of another planet (Venus).

zh.s: 金星计划（俄语：Вене́ра，读音为[vʲɪˈnʲɛrə]，意为“金星”）是苏联于1961年至1984年研制的一系列金星探测器，旨在收集有关金星的信息。苏联共发射了18个探测器，其中包括两个相关的织女星探测器。13个探测器成功进入金星大气层，包括两艘金星—哈雷探测器；其中10个成功在金星表面着陆。
zh.n: 苏联金星计划：金星7号发射。它后来成为首个成功从另一颗行星（金星）表面传回数据的航天器。

en.s: The Battle of Agios Dometios (Greek: Μάχη του Αγίου Δομετίου), also known as Battle of ELDYK (Greek: Μάχη της ΕΛΔΥΚ) was an engagement between Greek, Greek Cypriot, Turkish and Turkish Cypriot forces between 14 and 17 August 1974. It was part of the Attila-2 (Second phase of the invasion) operation as described by Turkey and the wider battle for Nicosia as described by Cyprus.

zh.s: 圣多梅蒂奥斯战役（希腊语：Μάχη του Αγίου Δομετίου）也称ELDYK战役（希腊语：Μάχη της ΕΛΔΥΚ），是希腊、希族塞人、土耳其和土族塞人部队于1974年8月14日至17日之间发生的一场交战。土耳其方面将其列为“阿提拉2号”行动（入侵第二阶段）的一部分，塞浦路斯方面则将其视为更大范围的尼科西亚战役的一部分。

en.s: The 1974 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1973–74 DFB-Pokal, the 31st season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 17 August 1974 at the Rheinstadion in Düsseldorf. Eintracht Frankfurt won the match 3–1 against Hamburger SV after extra time, to claim their 1st cup title.

zh.s: 1974年德国足协杯决赛决出了1973—74赛季冠军，这也是德国淘汰制杯赛的第31个赛季。比赛于1974年8月17日在杜塞尔多夫的莱茵体育场举行。法兰克福在加时赛后以3比1击败汉堡，首次夺得足协杯冠军。

en.s: The 1976 Moro Gulf earthquake and tsunami occurred on August 17, 1976, at 00:11 local time near the islands of Mindanao and Sulu, in the Philippines. It measured 8.0 on the moment magnitude scale occurring at a depth of 20 km (12 mi). The earthquake was accompanied by a destructive tsunami that resulted in a majority of the estimated 5,000 to 8,000 fatalities. It was the deadliest earthquake in Philippines history and strongest earthquake in the Philippines in 58 years since the 1918 Celebes Sea earthquake.

zh.s: 1976年8月17日当地时间00:11，菲律宾棉兰老岛和苏禄群岛附近发生莫罗湾地震并引发海啸。地震矩震级为8.0，震源深度20公里（12英里）。随之而来的破坏性海啸造成估计5,000至8,000人死亡，其中大多数死于海啸。这是菲律宾历史上伤亡最惨重的地震，也是自1918年西里伯斯海地震以来58年间菲律宾最强的地震。

zh.s: 1979年葡萄牙超级杯是该项赛事的第一届，但并非首届正式比赛。葡萄牙超级杯是每年举行的新赛季揭幕战，由上赛季联赛冠军对阵杯赛冠军；若同一球队包揽两项冠军，则由杯赛亚军参赛。

en.s: The 1985–1986 Hormel strike was a labor strike that involved approximately 1,500 workers of the Hormel meatpacking plant in Austin, Minnesota, United States. en.s: The 1985 Nunawading Province by-election was held on 17 August 1985 to elect the member for Nunawading Province in the Victorian Legislative Council. en.s: On 17 August 1988, a Lockheed C-130B Hercules operated by the Pakistan Air Force with thirty people onboard crashed in Bahawalpur, Pakistan. Among the victims were President Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq, his close confidant CJCSC Akhtar Abdur Rahman, ISPR director-general Siddique Salik and United States ambassador Arnold Lewis Raphel. Zia's death was officially announced a few hours later on Radio Pakistan and Pakistan Television Network by Ghulam Ishaq Khan, the Chairman of the Senate of Pakistan, who assumed the presidency.

zh.t: 1988年巴基斯坦空军C-130B运输机坠毁事件
zh.s: 1988年8月17日，一架由巴基斯坦空军运营的洛克希德C-130B“大力神”运输机在巴基斯坦巴哈瓦尔布尔坠毁，机上有30人。遇难者包括总统穆罕默德·齐亚·哈克、他的亲信兼参谋长联席会议主席阿赫塔尔·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼、三军公共关系局局长西迪克·萨利克，以及美国大使阿诺德·拉斐尔。数小时后，巴基斯坦参议院主席古拉姆·伊沙克·汗在巴基斯坦广播电台和巴基斯坦电视台正式宣布齐亚去世，并接任总统。

en.t: Iran and Iraq begin releasing prisoners of war
en.s: The Iran–Iraq War, also called the First Imposed War, Eight-Year War, or Sacred Defense by Iran, began with the Iraqi invasion of Iran in September 1980. After eight years of conflict, both countries accepted a ceasefire deal brokered by the United Nations, which became effective in August 1988. The war caused around 500,000 deaths (excluding numbers from the related Anfal campaign), making it the deadliest conventional war ever fought between regular armies of developing countries.

zh.t: 伊朗和伊拉克开始释放战俘

en.s: SummerSlam (2008) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on August 17, 2008, at Conseco Fieldhouse in Indianapolis. en.s: On 17 August 2019, a suicide bombing took place during a wedding in a wedding hall in Kabul, Afghanistan. At least 92 people were killed in the attack and over 140 injured. The Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant claimed responsibility for the bombing, stating that the attack targeted the Shi'ites. More than 1,000 people were gathered for the wedding when the attack took place. The attack occurred a day before the 100th Afghan Independence Day, causing the government to postpone the planned celebrations taking place at the Darul Aman Palace. It was the deadliest attack in Kabul since January 2018.

en.s: The 2019–20 Zambian Charity Shield (also known as The Samuel ‘Zoom’ Ndhlovu Memorial Charity Shield) was the 54th Charity Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Super League and ABSA Cup. This was the second editions in 2019 due to the transitional from a calendar year season to a spring-fall season. This seasons’ Charity Shield match puts 2019 transitional Super League and ABSA Cup winners Zesco United against ABSA Cup runners up Zanaco. Before the 2019-20 Charity Shield final Zesco United featured in the previous 2019 final against Nkana, Zesco lost that match 5–4 on penalties. Zanaco defeated Zesco 1–0 with the only goal being scored by Ziyo Tembo. That defeat for Zesco United was the third consecutive season they have failed to win the Charity Shield, having lost the two previous to Nkana. The match was played at Woodlands Stadium on 17 August 2019.
